cover.coreProposition: MCP OAuth clients should select expected issuer identity before following discovery indirection, bind every authority-bearing artifact and response to it, and fail closed on mismatch or downgrade; discovery location must not redefine credential authority.
cover.visualMetaphor: One credential path follows several redirects while a fixed luminous identity anchor rejects a divergent endpoint
cover.semanticObject: A sequence of discovery portals around one immutable issuer beacon, with one mismatched branch visibly blocked
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a stable center of authority and controlled indirection, avoiding literal protocol diagrams
